from pypdf import PdfReader
r = PdfReader('report.pdf')
print('Final pages:', len(r.pages))
print('Metadata:', dict(r.metadata))
for i, p in enumerate(r.pages):
    try:
        contents = p['/Contents'].get_object().get_data().decode('latin-1')
        text = contents.replace('\n', ' | ')
    except Exception:
        text = '(via extract_text) ' + (p.extract_text() or '').replace('\n', ' | ')
    print(f'Page {i+1}:', text[:220])
EOF
